mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC of FEDFUNDS on 20-day SPX returns is below 0.03 in any 12-month rolling window, or average 20-day returns during declining FEDFUNDS periods are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate (UNRATE) increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals labor market deterioration and reduced consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In more than 40% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 6.3%), 5-day SPX returns are positive, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is negative.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate contracting consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative 60-day returns in >50% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In supply-driven expansion regimes (INDPRO > 105.0), rising industrial production signals robust economic output, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day SPX returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) during INDPRO > 105.0 periods, or Rank IC < 0.04 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals strengthening labor market conditions and rising consumer spending, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC of PAYEMS on 5-day SPX returns < 0.03 in any 12-month window, or average 5-day returns during PAYEMS growth are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) falling below 1400.0 thousand units signals housing market weakness and reduced consumer confidence, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In >45% of triggered instances (HOUST < 1400.0), 60-day SPX returns are positive, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is negative.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL > 265.0 indicates monetary policy response to inflation, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to recession risk.
failure_condition: Joint condition (FEDFUNDS decline + CPIAUCSL > 265.0) fails to predict negative 20-day returns in >50% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 265.0), rising consumer prices trigger expectations of aggressive monetary tightening, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In >45% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL > 265.0), 60-day SPX returns are positive, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is negative.
